notes.glasses: Thick frames, dark glasses, tinted lenses strictly prohibited. Clear lenses permitted if eyes fully visible without reflections.
notes.smile: Natural neutral expression, mouth firmly closed, facing camera straight-on.
notes.ears: Both ears and full front facial oval should ideally be visible.
notes.shadows: No shadows on face, neck, or white background.
notes.babyRules: For babies, neutral background, eyes open, no pacifiers, toys, or parent hands visible.
